Sample.evidence_source: A consecutive sample of 52 men was selected from three hospitals in the Dublin area within the same general geographical area.

Country.evidence_source: A consecutive sample of 52 men was selected from three hospitals in the Dublin area within the same general geographical area.

Population.evidence_source: Inclusion criteria included gender (male), age (18e30 years) and intent, in that all those included in the study had made a suicide attempt with definite intent to die.

Type.evidence_source: The participants were interviewed, by the author, as soon as possible after a suicidal action (depending on the extent of their injuries) but usually within 24 h. An unstructured interview schedule was used in the session consisting of one introductory question 'Can you tell me how you came to be admitted here?'
